verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions kanban boards, board columns, or drag-and-drop work tracking. It only offers a generic 'from planning' marketing line and community praise for issue tracking, which are adjacent features and not the board capability the story asks for. Project planning is a fair axis for a DevSecOps platform like GitLab, so absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plan and track work on kanban boards with columns
